geometry_policy: Metadata-only join. GLB files, geometries, coordinates, feature IDs, heights and existing material assignments are never modified by this process.
matching_policy: Exact OSM IDs first. OpenFreeMap fallback spatial links require centroid containment, acceptable area ratio and an unambiguous candidate; ambiguous candidates are recorded but do not supply semantic tags. House numbers are linked only when a single building footprint covers or is within 2.5 m of the label point. Image candidates remain unverified until reviewed.
